workflow.name: Multi-Asset Daily Market Snapshot
workflow.description: Automated multi-asset market analysis: fetch prices → normalize → AI insights → log → email report.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: OpenAI-compatible API key for market insights generation

TWELVEDATA_API_KEY.description: TwelveData API key (mocked with local data)

workflow_steps.name: Set market assets
workflow_steps.description: Define asset groups: Indices (SPY, QQQ, DIA), Forex (EUR/USD, etc.), Commodities (XAU/USD, USO)

workflow_steps.name: Split assets into symbols
workflow_steps.description: Split comma-separated asset groups into individual symbol records

workflow_steps.name: Fetch Indices prices
workflow_steps.description: Fetch daily price data for Indices: SPY, QQQ, DIA (mock TwelveData API)

workflow_steps.name: Fetch Forex prices
workflow_steps.description: Fetch daily price data for Forex: EUR/USD, USD/INR, GBP/USD, USD/JPY (mock TwelveData API)

workflow_steps.name: Fetch Commodities prices
workflow_steps.description: Fetch daily price data for Commodities: XAU/USD, USO (mock TwelveData API)

workflow_steps.name: Generate AI market insights
workflow_steps.description: Use gpt-4.1-mini to generate professional daily market report from normalized data

workflow_steps.name: Parse AI output
workflow_steps.description: Extract structured sections: summary, movers, sentiment, insight, outlook
